answer: A newcomer can vote only after three sponsors each sign a signal vouching for it and lock velvet behind that signal, forfeited if the newcomer is ever proven a clone. The orchard records every signal, so a newcomer whose sponsor already backs m seats needs that sponsor to lock m+1 velvet. An honest arrival with fresh sponsors costs 3 velvet. An operator pushing 100 clones through the same three bribed sponsors locks 15,150 velvet, all at risk on one slash, or must bribe 300 unrelated sponsors who each risk their own stake.
